Enum Class MhdIdentifierType

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<MhdIdentifierType>
org.openehealth.ipf.commons.ihe.fhir.mhd.model.MhdIdentifierType
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<MhdIdentifierType>, Constable
public enum MhdIdentifierType extends Enum<MhdIdentifierType>
The kinds of identifier MHD distinguishes on DocumentReference.identifier and List.identifier, i.e. the codes of the IHE.MHD.MHDIdentifierType code system.

Up to MHD 4.2.3 the two were told apart by Identifier.use (official for the entryUUID, usual for the uniqueId). MHD 4.2.4 replaced that with a fixed Identifier.type coding and changed the slicing discriminator accordingly (CP-ITI-1328-01). IPF writes both, so that the resources it builds validate against either version of the profiles, and matches(Identifier) reads both, so that identifiers received from a peer that still only sets use are recognized as well.

Since:
6.0
Author:
Christian Ohr

    • matches

      public boolean matches(Identifier identifier)
      Tells whether an identifier is of this kind. The MHD 4.2.4 Identifier.type coding takes precedence; an identifier that carries no coding of the MHD code system at all is classified by its Identifier.use, the way MHD 4.2.3 and earlier did.
      Parameters:
      identifier - identifier to inspect, may be null
      Returns:
      true if the identifier denotes this kind of identifier
